summary: feat(settings): switch the integration in-app instead of hard-reloading
description:
Because:

* GleanMetrics.initialize is async, but its type said void
* The emit-time Glean test passed even when queued events were dropped

This commit:

* Types GleanMetrics.initialize as returning Promise<void>
* Awaits initialize in the two setIntegration Glean tests
* Asserts the exact client ID calls of the queued events

Closes FXA-14791
